attBesluta.text: Extremely well packaged. Got it assembled; now can't wait to use it! Re assembly: Parts separately blister packed for each step so it's easy to use the right ones. Tools included but using my own (Craftsman) helped speed things up. To prevent improper installation, look at every picture.
ArIt was exactly what described. Installation was extremely simple and manual is clear. I didn't use the tools came with it. I used my own tools. Other than that it's great product.
Très bon produit, très solide et maniable. Je l'utilise pour transporter une motopompe avec 60m de tuyau...

Une superbe brouette! Nous avons opté pour le modèle 1500 afin d’évacuer des débris de béton. Même chargée au maximum, elle reste étonnamment facile à tirer (même pour ma fille). La hauteur est vraiment agréable et préserve bien le dos. La qualité d’assemblage et la solidité sont au rendez-vous. Un achat très utile que je ne regrette absolument pas!
Great dump cart, bought it to move and haul firewood, definitely an upgrade.

Used once so far, replaced my old screen tent and there's no comparison. I use it for my kitchen set up and have extra room for a table and camping chair if I want to hang out inside. The Vevor gazebo tent is amazing, so easy to put up and includes all 6 privacy/rain covers making it completely private if needed. It rained 8 hours straight (my luck picking weekends to camp) and water seeped through some on the walls mainly where the hole is for the pull strap, but not a single drop came through the roof. The dirt floor stayed perfectly dry. A little harder to take down but I managed alone. Highly recommend!
The gazebo look sturdy and the fabric and stitches are immaculate. Really easy to pop it up. The peg provided are of high quality

Love it! As advertised. We loved using it. We camped over a weekend that was 80⁰ and 50⁰. Putting the sides up to block the wind was incredible. Big enough for 4 people, but roomy for 2. We sat in it while it was raining and enjoyed our view of the lake while warm and dry. I recommend buying this instead of the expensive one.

Cumpărat în luna iulie,foarte bine proiectat se montează în 5 minute,îl poate monta o singura persoană si îți oferă protecție totală contra țânțarilor muștelor si alte micro insecte. Protecție împotriva undelor solare,folosit pentru 3 săptămâni cu intemperii destul de puternice,vintul nu a reușit sa-l doboare în comparație cu alte produse. 5 stele oferite si meritate.
